title: Step-by-step Directions Worksheets | K–2nd Coding Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Standards aligned: CSTA 1A-AP-08

Give your learners extra practice with Step-by-step Directions! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Robot Step by Step
  • How Many Steps?
  • What Comes First?
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Robot Step by Step, How Many Steps?, What Comes First?), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Holidays, Art & Coding Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
